headline: Revenue and earnings continue to climb across the board
summary_short: Landstar reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,432.3M, up 22.3% q/q and 18.2% y/y, with diluted EPS of $1.44, up 24.1% q/q and 20.0% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue rose to $1,432.3M (+22.3% q/q, +18.2% y/y). Gross profit reached $189.0M (+17.0% q/q, +19.4% y/y). Operating income climbed to $63.5M (+19.3% q/q, +12.9% y/y) and EBITDA to $73.9M (+21.6% q/q, +14.3% y/y). Net income rose to $49.0M (+24.1% q/q, +16.8% y/y), and diluted EPS increased to $1.44 (+24.1% q/q, +20.0% y/y).
